name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Friends sync much faster and more reliably, with thanks to Stephan Voeth (@svoeth), whose contribution is still under review, so please report any problems. After the first sync only new or changed titles are downloaded, large removals wait for you to confirm them, music syncs with its albums, songs and artists, friends shared individual libraries now see them, and the Libraries tab shows what each friend library is doing. You can choose what a new friend sees before sending or accepting a request, reconnect a friend after a reinstall, and fully resync one library. Also fixes a security hole where a malicious friend could make a download write a file outside the downloads folder.
